source_section: 统一设计文档 §5.1–§5.7，卡牌 ID 表行；卡牌专属原文以 source_line 记录

cards.behavior: complete 14; same-segment +4 if K04 was played this round; upgrade base 18; references card K04
cards.source_row: | K05 | 细心写 | 2·工作·白 | 完成14；本回合打过K04则额外完成4，合并为同一段 | 基础18 |

cards.behavior: complete 3 and gain_focus 1; exhaust; upgrade completion 5
cards.source_row: | K06 | 潦草急就 | 0·工作·蓝 | 完成3，获得1专注；耗尽 | 完成5 |

cards.behavior: recall one discard card to hand; exhaust; unavailable without a legal discard target; upgrade cost 0
cards.source_row: | K07 | 复盘 | 1·策略·蓝 | 选弃牌堆1张加入手牌；耗尽；无目标不可用 | 费用0 |

cards.behavior: heal 3, relax 3, remove one anxiety; exhaust; upgrade heal 5
cards.source_row: | K08 | 运动 | 1·策略·蓝 | 恢复3精力，获得3放松，移除1焦虑；耗尽 | 恢复5 |

cards.behavior: pay vitality_cost 4, gain_focus 2; exhaust; upgrade vitality_cost 3
cards.source_row: | K10 | 熬夜 | 0·策略·蓝 | 支付4精力，获得2专注；耗尽 | 支付3 |

cards.behavior: discard up to 2 then draw 1 plus actual discarded count; upgrade pre_effects relax 2
cards.source_row: | K12 | 转换思路 | 1·策略·白 | 弃至多2张，抽实际弃牌数+1 | 获得2放松后再执行 |

cards.behavior: gain one compile; once per card instance per round; upgrade compile 2
cards.source_row: | K13 | 编译 | 0·策略·白 | 获得1编译；每实例每回合限打1次 | 编译2 |

cards.behavior: complete 5 plus 3 in the same segment when compile is present; upgrade base 7
cards.source_row: | K14 | 打印Hello | 1·工作·白 | 完成5；编译≥1时同段+3 | 基础7 |

cards.behavior: complete 4 and draw 1; upgrade completion 6
cards.source_row: | K15 | 循环练习 | 1·工作·白 | 完成4，抽1 | 完成6 |

cards.behavior: choose one negative status and remove up to 2 stacks; gain compile 1; upgrade compile 2
cards.source_row: | K16 | 调试 | 1·策略·蓝 | 净化2层负面，获得1编译 | 编译2 |

cards.behavior: relax 5 and choose another hand card to retain through discard; upgrade relax 8
cards.source_row: | K19 | 版本控制 | 1·策略·白 | 获得5放松，保留另一张手牌 | 放松8 |

cards.behavior: summon F01; exhaust; upgrade new unit vitality +3; reference unit F01
cards.source_row: | K43 | 室友搭把手 | 1·合作·白 | 召入F01；耗尽 | 单位上限精力+3 |

cards.behavior: summon F02; exhaust; upgrade new unit cooperation +2; reference unit F02
cards.source_row: | K44 | 请教学霸 | 2·合作·白 | 召入F02；耗尽 | 单位协作+2 |

cards.behavior: summon F03; exhaust; upgrade new unit vitality +3; reference unit F03
cards.source_row: | K45 | 请教助教 | 1·合作·蓝 | 召入F03；耗尽 | 单位上限精力+3 |

cards.behavior: summon F04; exhaust; upgrade new unit vitality +4; reference unit F04
cards.source_row: | K46 | 组队分工 | 2·合作·蓝 | 召入F04；耗尽 | 单位上限精力+4 |

cards.behavior: establish L01; exhaust; upgrade cost 0; reference scene L01
cards.source_row: | K51 | 回到自家 | 1·场景·蓝 | 建立L01；耗尽 | 费用0 |

cards.behavior: establish L02; exhaust; upgrade pre_effects relax 3 before scene establishment; reference scene L02
cards.source_row: | K52 | 宿舍自习 | 1·场景·白 | 建立L02；耗尽 | 建立前获得3放松 |

cards.behavior: establish L03; exhaust; upgrade pre_effects relax 4 before scene establishment; reference scene L03
cards.source_row: | K53 | 找到自习室 | 2·场景·紫 | 建立L03；耗尽 | 建立前获得4放松 |

cards.behavior: complete 12 plus 10 in the same segment when DDL <= 3; upgrade base 16
cards.source_row: | K59 | 临时抱佛脚 | 2·工作·紫 | 完成12；当前DDL≤3时同段+10 | 基础16 |

cards.behavior: relax 4, draw 1, remove one extra_requirements stack from selected task; upgrade relax 7
cards.source_row: | K60 | 检查卷面 | 1·策略·白 | 获得4放松，抽1，移除目标任务1层额外要求 | 放松7 |

cards.behavior: temporary, rarity null, unplayable, no effects; remains eligible for normal end-of-round discard
cards.source_row: | X01 | 分心消息 | 临时，不可打出；回合末正常弃置，无被动扣费 |
